AI 반도체 수요 재점화는 긍정적이나, 기술적 지표는 관망 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but shows directional absence at 58.4, consolidating in neutral territory. MACD histogram is improving but remains negative. Five consecutive daily gains maintain a Higher Low pattern relative to the 5-day high of $228.50 and 20-day high of $234.76. However, ADX at 13.3 indicates weakening trend strength. At 87.3% of the 52-week high, upside potential exists, but approaching the upper Bollinger Band at $232.35 may increase selling pressure. With a 1x target allocation filled, leverage entry requires caution. While AI semiconductor demand re-ignition is positive, technical indicators suggest a wait-and-see approach.
